item.text: {"confident":true,"explanation":"This tests solving a first-order linear ODE using an integrating factor, matching topic 877. The integrating factor is exp(∫x/6 dx)=exp(x²/12). Multiplying and integrating gives y=6+C exp(-x²/12); y(0)=5 implies C=-1, so y=6-exp(-x²/12).","answers":[],"diagnostic_classification":"in_course","diagnostic_topic_id":877}
